beats.say: 76,500 people: BioWare is at the centre of a massive petition after EA announced its closure.
The publisher shared plans to shut down the legendary studio on Tuesday 21 October.
According to IGN, fans are now urging EA to sell off the studio's famous titles.
The petition asks for Mass Effect 5 to be handed to a different team.
Some players are even calling for a total boycott of all EA games in response.
Losing BioWare means the future of your favourite stories now depends on a corporate sell off.
Will you join the boycott to save Mass Effect? Subscribe for one of these every day.

facts: EA announced plans to shut down BioWare on October 21.
A fanmade petition has over 76,500 signatures.
Fans are calling for an EA boycott.
The petition asks EA to sell the IPs or move development of Mass Effect 5.
